title: HSS-LMS public key (rfc-8778) - DERIVED, not verbatim
description: DERIVED. RFC 8778 ships no JSON Schema (the string 'JSON Schema' occurs 0 times in its 772 lines) and prints no key of any kind. This schema validates a PARSED HSS-LMS public key - the `pub` parameter of a COSE kty 5 key, split into the four fields RFC 8778 section 2.2 names - expressed as lowercase hex so a test harness can carry it in JSON. The wire form is a single 56-octet CBOR bstr (see hss-lms-public-key.derived.cddl); this is a model of its contents, not an encoding of it. Widths: 4 and 4 measured from Appendix A in TWO legs, neither sufficient alone - the only u32str width in {1, 2, 8} that makes the printed 2512-octet signature an integer number of 32-octet elements (the divisibility test by itself holds for every u = 4 mod 8, so u = 12, 20 and 28 pass it too), and the only width consistent with the printed octets, which carry u32str(0) at offset 0 and the leaf number q at offset 4; see schema/README.md for both legs. 16 stated in section 3 (rfc-8778#R-0092), 32 from m=32 in section 2.2 (rfc-8778#R-0039 with #R-0052). Derived 2026-10-20, FX-1 pass 1 (extract); the width wording corrected 2026-10-21 by FX-1 pass 3, which found this the one site of nine where pass 2's correction did not land; reviewed_by empty.

pub_hex.description: The whole 56-octet pub value as lowercase hex. rfc-8778#R-0053, rfc-8778#R-0024, rfc-8778#R-0127.

lms_algorithm_type.description: Octets 0-3 as an unsigned 32-bit integer. An IANA code point in the LMS registry [HASHSIG] establishes (rfc-8778#R-0046). RFC 8778 prints no value for any of its five named tree sizes, so this field cannot be resolved to a name from RFC 8778 alone.

otstype.description: Octets 4-7 as an unsigned 32-bit integer. An IANA code point in the LM-OTS registry [HASHSIG] establishes (rfc-8778#R-0077). RFC 8778 prints no value for any of its four named variants.

I_hex.description: Octets 8-23: the 16-octet tree identifier. rfc-8778#R-0092 states the width; rfc-8778#R-0049 puts it in the public key; rfc-8778#R-0090 allows it as a COSE kid. Nothing in RFC 8778 binds a kid to this value, so a mismatch is unconstrained.

T1_hex.description: Octets 24-55: the m-byte Merkle root, m = 32. rfc-8778#R-0052 with rfc-8778#R-0039.

lms_algorithm_type_name.description: Optional. One of RFC 8778 section 2.2's five names, if the resolver knows the registry. RFC 8778 itself supplies no mapping.

otstype_name.description: Optional. One of RFC 8778 section 2.3's four names, if the resolver knows the registry.
